provenance.paper_title: ScrapMem: Multimodal Scrapbook Memory for Long-Horizon Agents

evidence.paraphrase: Scrapbook pages retain perceptual snippets while progressively reducing their optical fidelity.
A causal-temporal episodic graph links retained scraps into searchable events.

evidence.section: Full paper: Memory Systems for Personalized Agents
evidence.paraphrase: Optical forgetting lowers page resolution as memories age. For ScrapMem, this specifically supports progressive decay of stored importance or retention of Scrapbook Pages.
New scraps are integrated into the causal-temporal episode graph. For ScrapMem, this specifically supports relinking or reindexing of stored items of Scrapbook Pages.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (Scrapbook Pages) changes through progressive decay of stored importance or retention, relinking or reindexing of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
